name: Waiting for Players
description: Six people gather at Mount Lao.

name: Role Assignment
description: Each player receives one role connected to Wang Qi's failed spell.

name: Return to the Temple
description: Introduce your public identity and explain why you came back.
fallback_message: I am the quiet voice of Mount Lao. A wall was struck, a spell failed, and every person here carries part of the explanation. Introduce yourselves in English, protect your private motives, and ask the host when you need a lead.

name: Search the Mountain Temple
description: Inspect the study, wood shed, guest room, and temple wall.

name: What Does Clean Mean?
description: Connect the exam failure, the master's warning, and the failed demonstration.

name: The Temple's Explanation
description: Vote for the explanation that best fits the evidence.

name: The Wall and the Heart
description: The host reconstructs Wang Qi's journey and explains every character's choice.
